proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C r s t hδ
  set D := AffineMap.lineMap B C r with hD
  set E := AffineMap.lineMap C A s with hE
  set F := AffineMap.lineMap A B t with hF
  set u : V := B -ᵥ A with hu
  set w : V := C -ᵥ A with hw
  have hCB : C -ᵥ B = w - u := (vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right C B A).symm
  have hAC : A -ᵥ C = -w := (neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev C A).symm
  have eD : D -ᵥ A = (1 - r) • u + r • w := by
    rw [hD, AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_vsub_assoc, hCB, ← hu]; module
  have eE : E -ᵥ A = (1 - s) • w := by
    rw [hE, AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_vsub_assoc, hAC, ← hw]; module
  have eF : F -ᵥ A = t • u := by
    rw [hF, AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_vsub_assoc, vsub_self, add_zero]
  have eX : D -ᵥ F = (1 - r - t) • u + r • w := by
    rw [← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right D F A, eD, eF]; module
  have eY : E -ᵥ F = (-t) • u + (1 - s) • w := by
    rw [← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right E F A, eE, eF]; module
  have hδ' : (1 - r - t) * (1 - s) + t * r = 0 := by linear_combination hδ
  have hcase : ∃ c : ℝ, (D -ᵥ F = c • (E -ᵥ F)) ∨ (E = F) := by
    by_cases ht : t = 0
    · by_cases hs : 1 - s = 0
      · refine ⟨0, Or.inr ?_⟩
        exact eq_of_vsub_eq_zero (by rw [eY, ht, hs]; simp)
      · have hr : 1 - r - t = 0 := by
          have : (1 - r - t) * (1 - s) = 0 := by rw [ht] at hδ' ⊢; linarith
          exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_right hs
        refine ⟨r / (1 - s), Or.inl ?_⟩
        rw [eX, eY, hr, ht, smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hs]
        simp
    · refine ⟨-(1 - r - t) / t, Or.inl ?_⟩
      have hc : -(1 - r - t) / t * (1 - s) = r := by
        field_simp
        linear_combination -hδ'
      rw [eX, eY, smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul, hc]
      congr 1
      congr 1
      field_simp
  rw [collinear_iff_of_mem (p₀ := F) (by simp)]
  obtain ⟨c, hc | hc⟩ := hcase
  · refine ⟨E -ᵥ F, ?_⟩
    intro p hp
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp
    rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨c, by rw [← hc, vsub_vadd]⟩
    · exact ⟨1, by rw [one_smul, vsub_vadd]⟩
    · exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  · refine ⟨D -ᵥ F, ?_⟩
    intro p hp
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp
    rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨1, by rw [one_smul, vsub_vadd]⟩
    · exact ⟨0, by simpa using hc⟩
    · exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C : P) (r s t : ℝ), r * s * t = -((1 - r) * (1 - s) * (1 - t)) → Collinear ℝ ({AffineMap.lineMap B C r, AffineMap.lineMap C A s, AffineMap.lineMap A B t} : Set P)
